scale_basis: The hall is about 32 m long (architecture.json structure). The drawn hall floor spans image x 0.105-0.8875, so 0.7825 x 40.5 m = 31.7 m, and the image width is 40.5 m (= layout.json map_extent_m). Z = 40.5 x 9/16 = 22.781 m. Y = vault crown 2.8 m. Door leaves use the Bible 0.85 x 1.95 m size.
orientation_note: Top of the image is the WEST wall; north end at the left edge, south end at the right edge (layout.json orientation).

walkable.hall_floor: x 0.105-0.8875, y 0.356-0.653: 31.7 m x 6.8 m clear, no obstacles except the glass table (0.5 m round, 0.72 m tall) at [0.64, 0.5]. The lamp undersides are at 2.1 m (clear for Alice at 135 cm; a 274 cm Alice hits the lamps and the 2.8 m vault).
walkable.entrance: Gap in the east wall at x 0.24-0.31: 2.8 m clear width as drawn, 2.1 m clear height under entrance_lintel. The passage runs south off the map edge, 2.8 m wide. Walking in from the passage: go through the gap, clear the 1.23 m wall depth with the whole body, then turn north or south into the hall.
walkable.doors: All 20 side doors and the south door are closed and locked: blocking surfaces, not passages. The little door (0.26 x 0.38 m) is behind the low curtain at [0.745, 0.355].

inferred_items: Door leaves: Bible size 0.85 x 1.95 m placed at the drawn notch centres (drawn notches are about 1.3 m wide).
Lamps: 11 drawn positions, 0.35 m globes hung at 2.3 m centre height (the hang height is inferred).
Curtain: 1.8 m long (as drawn) x 0.6 m high (height inferred), hanging just in front of the little door.
Glass table: Bible 0.5 m top, height 0.72 m (from the x5.4 build's 3.9 m table), three 4 cm legs.
Entrance lintel at 2.1 m (from the passage clear height in SCN-shaft-landing-passage).
workflow_notes: The walls follow the drawn wall lines (image rule). Where the image departs from the Bible (DEF-p4-envconcept-603-b), the model follows the image/layout.json: the entrance is a side gap about 8 m from the north end, not the NE corner; there are 10 doors on the west wall and 9 on the east wall (the Bible says 12 + 12); the clear hall width is 6.8 m (the Bible says 5.5 m); the entrance passage is drawn 2.8 m wide (the Bible says 1.4 m). All inferred:true.
Glass table: the image draws a disc about 2.5 m across. The model uses the Bible 0.5 m table at the layout.json centre [0.64, 0.5]. The overlay shows the small table inside the drawn disc on purpose.
No ceiling or vault ribs are modelled, so the top view stays readable. The vault springs at 2.1 m and the crown is at 2.8 m.
Scaled builds (x5.4 under-table set, 1:2 miniature hall, x4.5 little-door build) keep the same xy and multiply metres by the build factor. This asset is the 1:1 hall.
Anti-clip handover: keep body envelopes 0.15 m off the wall faces and door leaves; plan the table as a 0.5 m round obstacle, and plan a 274 cm Alice against the 2.3 m lamp line and the 2.8 m crown.
